lessons.0.slides.1.title: 📋 Assessment Scope
lessons.0.slides.1.content:
This comprehensive assessment covers every module in the Level 3 course:

• M1 In-Depth Terroir Analysis
• M2 Master Domaine Studies
• M3 Professional Climate and Vintage Analysis
• M4 Soil and Geological Science
• M5 Advanced Winemaking Craft
• M6 Grand Cru Parcel Comparison
• M7 Market and Investment Analysis
• M8 Professional Collecting and Storage
• M9 Professional Blind Tasting Training
• M10 The Art of Food and Wine Pairing
• M11 Biodynamic Viticulture Research
• M12 Climate Change and the Future
• M13 Auction and Trading Practice
• M14 Professional Tasting Report Writing
• M15 Comprehensive Case Studies

The bank contains 155 questions; the system randomly draws 20. Passing score: 80 or above.
lessons.0.slides.2.title: 🎯 Key Review Points
lessons.0.slides.2.points.0: Terroir and geology: Kimmeridgian oyster-fossil soil, how slope aspect and elevation affect ripeness, top plots typically sit mid-slope
lessons.0.slides.2.points.1: Estates and winemakers: the style and holdings that define DRC, Leroy, Coche-Dury, Dujac, Comte de Vogüé, and others
lessons.0.slides.2.points.2: Reading vintages: 2003's excessive heat, 2005/2010/2019 as classic vintages, 2021's frost-driven low yields
lessons.0.slides.2.points.3: Comparing Grands Crus: Clos de Vougeot's upper/lower slope differences, the ownership structures of Musigny and Bonnes-Mares, the Montrachet family's 5 Grands Crus
lessons.0.slides.2.points.4: Winemaking craft: whole-cluster fermentation, cold maceration, malolactic fermentation (MLF), and bâtonnage — what they do and when they're used
lessons.0.slides.2.points.5: Biodynamics: founded by Rudolf Steiner, Demeter/Biodyvin certification, preparations 500 and 501
lessons.0.slides.2.points.6: Climate change: roughly 1.8°C of warming over the past 50 years, harvest dates about 4 weeks earlier, Chablis and the Hautes-Côtes as beneficiaries
lessons.0.slides.2.points.7: Market and collecting: auction buyer's premiums of 15-25%, the advantages of En Primeur, professional cellar temperature/humidity standards, authenticity verification
lessons.0.slides.2.points.8: ⚠️ Scoring 80 or above on this assessment unlocks the Level 4 Master course
